controller.formula: f = solve(I + dt*(kd + dt*kp)*Ainv, kp*(target-q) - (kd+dt*kp)*v), Ainv = (M^{-1})[finger_dof,finger_dof]
controller.derivation: Backward-Euler free-motion prediction q+ = q + dt*(v + dt*Ainv*f), v+ = v + dt*Ainv*f, with f = kp(target-q+) - kd*v+
controller.interpretation: ~25 N raw PD versus ~0.18-0.20 N implicit force is expected: dt*(kd+dt*kp)*Ainv is ~131, so free-motion backward-Euler force is attenuated ~1/132. It is not evidence of a coding error.
controller.cross_coupling: Ainv off-diagonal is small relative to diagonal (~0.5% correlation in archived I3), while full M inverse is the correct free-motion acceleration operator when other generalized forces are ignored.
controller.limitations: Ainv excludes bias/Coriolis/gravity terms, arm torques, unknown contact reactions and equality reactions. Thus it is a target-engine approximation, not PhysX implicit-drive equivalence and not a proof that omitted reactions are negligible.

semantic_notes: The one equality is a joint equality between finger_joint1 and finger_joint2.
The default collision condim is 4, so each active elliptic contact contributes four EFC rows in the archived traces.
qfrc_constraint aggregates all active equality and contact constraints; efc_type/efc_id/efc_address are the row-level disambiguation.

api_contract.mj_contactForce_signature_contract: result[0:3] force, result[3:6] torque in contact frame; input id is contact index

findings: The current formula is dimensionally consistent and independently reproduces every sampled archived actuator force to floating-point residual.

The finger equality is one mjEQ_JOINT row (efc_type 0, efc_id 0); elliptic contacts are mjCNSTR_CONTACT_ELLIPTIC rows (efc_type 7), normally four rows per condim=4 contact. Contact efc_address is the explicit mapping; contact array index and efc row ordering must not be conflated.

integration_stage is a solver/integration-stage snapshot before the wrapper mj_forward; post_forward_solver is recomputed at the advanced state. Their contact manifolds and qacc can differ and neither post-forward qfrc_constraint nor mj_contactForce is an integrated impulse history.
In I3 normal-arm, left geom4 disappears at 176 and the next state has severe multi-geom penetration at 177. Finger qdot jumps from about 0.0005 m/s to 0.08 m/s only after the manifold change.

In passive-arm, right geom5 disappears at 142, right positive pad force is lost at 143, and the large finger acceleration/peg rotation occurs at 144. Arm qdot remains below 0.001 rad/s through 144; this does not mean the arm is mechanically fixed, but it places contact/finger motion before large arm motion in this trace.

recommendation.reason: No mathematical implementation error or misread MuJoCo API is established. A controller replacement would change the target-engine adaptation without a defensible correction. Contact/equality coupling remains plausible but unisolated; keep R3/S2B NO-GO and do not run a candidate matrix solely from this audit.
